description: End a stored consent: Enable Banking is asked to close the session, which ends the bank's consent, and the label is removed from the stored consents (the file as it was is kept as a backup). Afterwards nothing can read those accounts until the account holder approves a new consent in their bank, so use it only when access should really stop (an account closed, an application retired, access no longer wanted). A consent the bank already ended is removed just the same. The label is required, always.

label.description: The consent to end, as list_stored_sessions names it.

name: revoke_session
title: Revoke a bank consent
